title: Diagnostic & Imaging
shortDesc: Ultrasound machines, blood pressure monitors, stethoscopes and high-precision diagnostic equipment.
fullDesc:
Our range of diagnostic and imaging solutions is designed to provide unparalleled precision to healthcare professionals. We offer CE-certified equipment compliant with ISO 13485 standards.

Whether you are a private practice or a large hospital, we have the solution tailored to your specific needs.

faq.q: What types of ultrasound machines do you offer?
faq.a: We offer portable and fixed ultrasound machines, with different probe configurations (convex, linear, endocavitary). All our devices are CE certified and ISO 13485 compliant.

faq.q: Are blood pressure monitors medically certified?
faq.a: Yes, all our blood pressure monitors are Class IIa medical devices, CE certified with clinical validation according to the ESH protocol.

faq.q: Do you offer training on how to use them?
faq.a: Yes, a basic training session is included with every purchase. Advanced training is available as an option.

title: Cardiology
shortDesc: ECG, defibrillators, cardiac monitors and holters for optimal surveillance.
fullDesc: Cardiology requires absolute reliability. Our cardiac monitoring and defibrillation equipment is designed for both emergency situations and daily follow-up.

faq.a: Yes, we offer 3, 6, and 12-lead ECGs according to your needs. All our ECGs feature a touch screen and an integrated thermal printer.
Yes, all our AEDs are designed for simple use with step-by-step voice guidance and automatic rhythm analysis in under 10 seconds.

title: Medical Imaging
shortDesc: CT scanners, MRI, digital radiology and PACS/RIS solutions.
fullDesc: Our medical imaging solutions cover all diagnostic needs of healthcare facilities. From 16-slice CT scanners to 3T MRI, we offer state-of-the-art equipment.

faq.a: Yes, we offer a complete range of CT scanners, from 16 to 128 slices, with installation and training included.

faq.q: Are MRIs compatible with all patients?
faq.a: Yes, our MRIs are adapted to all patient profiles, including children and claustrophobic individuals.

title: Surgery
shortDesc: Surgical instruments, autoclaves, surgical lights and operating tables.
fullDesc: Our surgery department offers all the equipment needed for modern operating rooms, from sterilization to lighting, including precision instruments.

faq.a: Yes, all our autoclaves are Class B, compliant with European standards EN 13060, with a vacuum drying cycle and complete traceability.
Yes, all our surgical lights are LED with a lifespan of 50,000 hours, a CRI > 95, and an intensity of up to 150,000 Lux.

title: Pediatrics
shortDesc: Neonatal incubators, pediatric scales, phototherapy and adapted equipment.
fullDesc: Our pediatric range is specially designed for the care of newborns and children, with adapted, secure and gentle equipment.

faq.q: Are incubators suitable for premature babies?
faq.a: Yes, our incubators are suitable for premature babies from 28 weeks of gestation, with precise control of temperature, humidity, and oxygen.
Yes, our pediatric scales have an accuracy of 5g with a Hold function for restless babies and a Tare function for diapers.

title: Emergency & Resuscitation
shortDesc: Defibrillators, emergency carts, multiparameter monitors and suction pumps.
fullDesc: The emergency department requires reliable and 24/7 available equipment. Our solutions are designed for speed, robustness and efficiency in critical situations.

faq.a: Yes, we offer AEDs (semi-automatic) and fully automatic defibrillators with voice guidance and rhythm analysis in under 10 seconds.
Yes, our carts are delivered with all necessary equipment: defibrillator, monitor, suction pump, oxygen, and emergency medications.

title: Medical Informatics
shortDesc: EHR, telemedicine, PACS/RIS and HDS cybersecurity.
fullDesc: Our medical informatics department offers comprehensive and secure solutions for the digitalization and management of healthcare facility data.

faq.q: Are your EHR solutions HDS compliant?
faq.a: Yes, all our EHR solutions are HDS certified (Health Data Host) and compliant with GDPR and Algerian regulations.
Yes, we offer complete teleconsultation, tele-expertise, and remote monitoring solutions with secure HD video conferencing.

title: Laboratory
shortDesc: Hematology analyzers, biochemistry, microscopes and centrifuges.
fullDesc: Our laboratory range covers all the needs of medical analysis laboratories, from entry-level to high-throughput, with guaranteed analytical precision.

faq.q: What types of analyzers do you offer?
faq.a: We offer hematology, biochemistry, immunology, and coagulation analyzers, from entry-level to high-throughput.
Starter reagents are included with each analyzer. We then offer reagent supply contracts at preferential rates.

title: Rehabilitation
fullDesc: Our rehabilitation department offers professional and ergonomic equipment for physiotherapy and functional rehabilitation centers.

faq.q: Do you offer neurological rehabilitation equipment?
faq.a: Yes, we offer neurological rehabilitation platforms, exoskeletons, and virtual reality systems.
Yes, our devices combine TENS, EMS, ultrasound, and therapeutic laser in a single compact device.
